OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📺 While you fought your fight, they fought theirs.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Werner — Combat 1. Three offers; they took Berserker Rage. Earned, chosen. (rage: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Werner chose Berserker Rage (rage) at Combat 1.
📺 Wave 1: The lead falls — the pack's coordination shatters. The rest scatter or die. (2 rounds, 2 taken)
📺 Werner WON. You didn't see it — you had your own arena. The village will tell you about it for weeks.
📺 Prize for Werner: the winner's share — alien rations for the pantry. The village eats tonight.
📺 The System presses something humming into Werner's hands: Adaptive Dermis. Grown from your own scar tissue and alien cultures. It remembers every wound.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ricardo Smirnov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Ricardo is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

🕯️ Ricardo's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
🕯️ Ricardo Smirnov is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Ricardo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Ricardo's gone." Gustavo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Ricardo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Siobhan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
📖 LEARNED: Engines (Level 1). Air, fuel, spark. Every dead engine is missing one of the three — diagnose in that order.
📖 LEARNED: Repair & Mending (Level 1). Look at what's broken before you touch it: find the failure point, not the symptom. Most breaks are one small thing.
📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
"OH! OH! PRECISE MEND! The audience did NOT see that coming! Knowledge AMPLIFIES power! The gamblers are recalculating EVERYTHING!"
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Ricardo Smirnov, 51 days. The mantle passes to Siobhan Bianchi.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Siobhan Bianchi, 45 — a mechanic. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Green Thumb, Literally, Cornucopia, Rain Dancer.
◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
The village's quarrel was with Ricardo — and Ricardo is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Axel, Werner, Asher and 6 more speak for Siobhan — "Ricardo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Siobhan before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
